backend_note: All quantum models use LOCAL Qiskit Statevector simulation. IBM Quantum hardware is NOT integrated.

data_strategy.test_balance: stratified at real fraud rate (~0.17%) -- expect ~0-1 fraud cases
data_strategy.features: 4 top features (V14, V4, V12, V8) -- selected by Phase 1 XGBoost importance
data_strategy.scaler: MinMaxScaler to [-pi, pi], fitted ONLY on training subset
data_strategy.reliability_warning: With ~1 fraud case in 25 test samples, quantum precision/recall/F1 have very limited statistical reliability. Phase 3 should use larger balanced test sets.

models.preprocessing: StandardScaler (fit on train only) + class_weight via scale_pos_weight=577.3
models.notes: Full dataset (284807 transactions), all 30 features. Threshold optimised to 0.70 for max F1.

models.backend: Qiskit Statevector (local ideal simulation — no IBM Quantum)
models.preprocessing: MinMaxScaler to [-pi, pi] (fit on train subset only)
models.notes: 4-qubit ZZFeatureMap (reps=2), balanced training (50/50 fraud/legit), stratified test. Subset: 100 train, 25 test. Train fraud=50, Test fraud=1.
models.reliability_note: Test set has very few fraud cases due to real imbalance (~0.17%). Precision/Recall/F1 have limited statistical meaning at this scale.

models.notes: ZZFeatureMap (reps=2), RealAmplitudes ansatz (reps=2), COBYLA optimizer (max_iter=20). Subset: 100 train, 25 test. Train fraud=50, Test fraud=1.
